name: Ilorin
scopeLimits: The WUP point is a settlement locator, not a municipal boundary. No anonymous full parcel polygon service was identified; no property or owner query was submitted.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official KW-GIS page describes land registration/title-search functions and locates its agency office in Ilorin. This establishes city-located registry activity; public parcel-vector coverage is unverified.
technicalBlocker: No anonymous public parcel viewer or full-polygon endpoint was found in inspected official KW-GIS pages. The public map-shop page exposed no downloadable polygon service; the linked Merlin application appears transaction-oriented and was not used to query land records.
remainingUncertainty: Whether KW-GIS has a separate anonymous map or public vector service beyond title-search/application workflow.
nextStep: If an anonymous geometry endpoint is later documented, inspect metadata and bounded full-polygon behavior only.
